PAPER-SHORT-20261010-001.label: Trend Pullback
PAPER-SHORT-20261010-001.why: Bade (4H) chart pe BTC ka trend neeche hai (taakat 0.32, kam se kam 0.30 chahiye thi). Us trend ke beech bhaav thoda upar chadha (2.5 ATR ki halchal) aur ab trend ki taraf palat raha hai (pichli 1H candle trend ke saath band hui). Isliye trend ke saath SELL liya. Stop-loss 3×ATR door rakha taaki chhoti uthal-puthal se na toote, target risk ka 4 guna. Backtest mein har 3 mein ~2 trade harte hain, isliye loss normal hai.
PAPER-SHORT-20261010-001.lesson: Dheere-dheere haar (39 ghante, best +0.0R): trend kamzor pad gaya aur bhaav kabhi hamare favour mein nahi gaya.
PAPER-SHORT-20261010-001.auto_feedback: 🟡 Normal haar: sirf tay risk (-1.1R) gaya. Is tarah ki strategy mein aksar 3 mein 2 trade harte hain.
